subject: Renewal pricing + capacity increase — safeguard termsheet discussion
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan.park@brightfield.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightfield Procurement <procurement@brightfield.ai>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@brightfield.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity bump — starting conversation

Hi Stephanie,

We're kicking off Brightfield's renewal conversation (term ends Aug 31). We want to:
- Move from our current 2M token/month commit to ~3.5M token/month (steady state) with 6M burst pool for peak events.
- Lock price for at least the first 12 months of the renewal to avoid the recent market volatility.
- Discuss a migration/onboarding credit to offset the engineering lift for model changes.

Attached is our usage projection for the next 18 months (BF_Usage_Projection_May26.xlsx). Can you share an outline of what pricing/credits Red wood could offer and any constraints for a price hold? Procurement would like to see a simple amendment they can attach to the SOW.

Best,
Susan
Susan Park
Head of ML Ops, Brightfield AI
[Attachment: BF_Usage_Projection_May26.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@brightfield.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — starting conversation

Hi Susan — thanks for the projection and clear asks. High level we can propose two paths depending on how Brightfield wants to balance commitment length vs credits:

Option A (18-month anchored commit):
- Commit: 3.5M tokens/month minimum for 18 months.
- Discount: 22% off list generation rates.
- Price hold: full 18 months (no unit price increases).
- Onboarding credit: $25k applied to first invoice.
- Burst pool: guaranteed access to 6M burst pool with soft-priority routing.

Option B (12-month renewal + higher up-front credit):
- Commit: 3.5M tokens/month minimum for 12 months.
- Discount: 15% off list generation rates.
- Price hold: 12 months.
- Onboarding credit: $40k (one-time).
- Post-term true-up: usage above commit reconciled at list price.

A couple of operational notes: price hold requires a minimum commit (above) and a signed amendment; burst pool reservation is limited by region and current capacity planning — if you need a hard SLA on burst capacity we can add a burst-reservation addendum for an additional fee.

If either option works, I can circulate a short amendment (one page) and route to Legal for the appropriate terms. Would you prefer Option A or B?

Thanks — I'll loop Marissa on approvals and Ben for finance impact.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — starting conversation

Looping in approvals — pulled preliminary P&L and spoke with finance. Quick steer:
- Approve Option B as the standard commercial (12-month price hold + $40k credit) if Brightfield signs within 10 business days. We see this as low operational risk and a clear expansion.
- If they push for 18 months at 22% discount, we require a 60% upfront prepay or a phased schedule (50% initial + 50% at month 9).
- We will not commit to a hard burst SLA without a burst-reservation fee; however, we can offer the soft-priority 6M pool for free for the first quarter post-renewal as a goodwill allocation.

Ben — can you confirm the revenue recognition/credit treatment so I can include it in the amendment draft?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Susan Park <susan.park@brightfield.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightfield Procurement <procurement@brightfield.ai>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@brightfield.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — starting conversation

Thanks Stephanie / Marissa,

Brightfield prefers Option B (12-month hold + $40k credit) but we have two asks before we proceed:
1) Can the price hold be explicitly scoped to generation tokens only (we'll accept non-generation add-on price variance)?
2) We need a clause that provides a single 30-day extension window to sign with the same pricing if procurement requires additional approvals.

I've attached a signed SOW draft for reference. If you can incorporate both items in the amendment, we can circulate for signature this week.

Best,
Susan
[Attachment: Brightfield_Signed_SOW.pdf (pdf)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@brightfield.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump — starting conversation

Susan — great, glad Option B is the path. Confirming the final commercial terms we'll put in the one-page amendment:
- Commit: 3.5M gen tokens/month for 12 months (minimum monthly commitment).
- Discount: 15% off Redwood generation rates; price hold applies to generation tokens only. Non-generation products and third-party infra pass-throughs excluded.
- One-time onboarding credit: $40,000 applied to the first invoice following the renewal effective date.
- Burst pool: 6M soft-priority pool (no hard SLA). One quarter (90 days) of prioritized access post-renewal included at no extra fee.
- 30-day single-signature extension window: Procurement may request one 30-day extension to sign the amendment and retain the same pricing.
- Post-term true-up: Overages reconciled at list price, with standard 60-day invoice terms.

Next steps: I'll have Legal and Finance prepare the amendment and DocuSign envelope (Deal RBW-4821-BF). Expect a DocuSign link early Monday. Once signed, we'll schedule a kickoff meeting w/ Brightfield engineering to scope the migration.

Link to DocuSign: https://redwood.docusign.com/Envelope/XYZ-9876
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821

—Stephanie
